svg.title: Native tilted-reference interferogram — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A 532 nm Mach–Zehnder combines equal-length object and reference arms on two cameras. A small reference-fold tilt creates a spatial carrier in the native camera profile. The camera resolves a one-dimensional supported coherent profile. This is a native off-axis interference acquisition bench; 2D hologram sampling, Fourier sideband reconstruction and numerical propagation are not implemented.
